title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.08.1
notes:
- Added the FL Studio 2005 theme with compact recording controls, vintage toolbar displays, Channel Rack and Mixer artwork, and a Traditional mixer layout that remembers its setting.
- The FL Studio 2005 cursor pack is the vintage theme default and can be selected in other themes. Windows users with a compatible FL Studio 4 installation can import its original cursors locally from the release source. Matching monochrome cursors cover missing artwork and other systems.
- Added independently selectable icon and cursor packs, individual icon and cursor choices, cursor sizing and visual color selection, and separate Mixer finish controls.
- Refined vintage mixer meters, shorter faders with full travel, stacked FX and disk-arm switches, stereo separation spacing, routing cables, slot dividers and value readouts.
- Added Mixer channel locks that prevent manual edits and preserve existing automation, plus visibility controls for mixer shortcuts and optional settings tabs.
- Added Playlist Bounce Audio in a new track or in place, clip color swatches, and a quick instrument picker in the Playlist.
- Piano Roll editing adds Place Pattern to Playlist, Alt-wheel row zoom, configurable zoom shortcuts, and right-click deselection. Editor scrolling and grid rendering are more consistent.
- Lemon EQ adds a compact band card with audition controls. The Mixer mini EQ has a separate bypass button.
- Improved Vocal Align previews and audition, and refined inline Vocal Tuning and automation controls in the vintage theme.
